maps.points.west_garden.dialogue: The plaque speaks of a statue concealed beyond sight.
maps.points.west_garden.dialogue-2: "Look carefully. Not every hidden threat is alive."
maps.points.west_garden.dialogue-3: The plaque describes the puzzle of weighted platforms.
maps.points.west_garden.dialogue-4: "The plates do not care what you throw. They care how heavy each piece is."
maps.points.west_garden.dialogue-5: The plaque refers to statues placed in some kind of garden room.
maps.points.west_garden.dialogue-6: "Not all shapes are born here. Some only appear when another place casts its echo."
